title: Program 0019: Moedex-managed submodule corpus
summary: Program plan tracking phased delivery of a Moedex-managed submodule corpus: init, sync, privacy-aware indexing, parity, and sibling cutover.
notes: Program/execution plan doc. Has goal/non-goals and a numbered 'Delivery contract' (PRD-like acceptance signals) plus phase tables and deviation rules, but no user stories, no decision/consequences sections, and no API/schema contracts. Status is 'In progress', and it defers the decision to ADR 0019 which it references. Classified DOC (planning/context) rather than PRD; ambiguity noted.
